say:1:1331021001:1.text: Whatever the guests have brought to the ball, you can find it here.
say:1:1331021001:1.source_cn: 什么都有——参加的化妆晚会的人带着什么，这里就有什么。
say:1:1331021001:1.male: Whatever the guests have brought to the ball, you can find it here.
say:1:1331021001:1.female: Whatever the guests have brought to the ball, you can find it here.

say:2:1331021002:1.text: People fled in all directions when the undead barged in, leaving their belongings scattered all over the floor.
say:2:1331021002:1.source_cn: 活死人冲进舞会之后，大家被吓得四处逃窜，东西丢了一地。
say:2:1331021002:1.male: People fled in all directions when the undead barged in, leaving their belongings scattered all over the floor.
say:2:1331021002:1.female: People fled in all directions when the undead barged in, leaving their belongings scattered all over the floor.

say:3:1331021003:1.text: I have to keep an eye out for valuable stuff while cleaning the streets—who knows, someone might come back looking for them soon.
say:3:1331021003:1.source_cn: 我一边清洁街道还得整理有用的东西，说不定过后还会有人来找。
say:3:1331021003:1.male: I have to keep an eye out for valuable stuff while cleaning the streets—who knows, someone might come back looking for them soon.
say:3:1331021003:1.female: I have to keep an eye out for valuable stuff while cleaning the streets—who knows, someone might come back looking for them soon.
